text:
You need a highly organized virtual administrative assistant who can keep calendars, communication, files, and project details moving accurately and on time, even in a flexible schedule.

Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis and reporting, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m used to handling structured information carefully, keeping things organized, and making sure deadlines and deliverables are clear and tracked.

For example, in my Sales KPI dashboard project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. That work replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project required careful organization, attention to detail, and consistent communication around priorities and progress, which are all valuable in an administrative support role.

While my background is in analytics, the same strengths apply directly to virtual administrative support: keeping information organized, maintaining clean records, preparing reports, and making sure work is delivered accurately. I’m comfortable working remotely, staying responsive, and managing multiple tasks without losing track of details. I also understand the importance of discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive information.

I can help with calendar organization, email correspondence, preparing reports and presentations, maintaining files, tracking deadlines, and supporting ongoing projects. Since your schedule is flexible and the role is up to 10 hours a week to start, I’d be happy to focus on the highest-priority tasks first and keep everything moving smoothly during the evaluation period.

What are the first 2–3 administrative tasks you’d like me to take over right away?
